legal.privacyContent:
1. Introduction

OrderShieldPro ("we", "us", or "our") is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and share your information when you use our trade entity verification platform.

2. Information We Collect

Account Information: Full name, email address, organization name, preferred language, and region when you register.

Review Content: Reviews, evidence files, severity ratings, narratives, and related trade details you submit.

Usage Data: Login activity, pages visited, search queries, and feature interactions collected automatically.

Device Data: Browser type, operating system, IP address, and device identifiers.

3. How We Use Your Information

We use your data to: operate and improve the platform; display reviews and entity profiles; send notifications about reviews, investigations, and account activity; enforce our Terms of Use; prevent fraud and abuse; and comply with legal obligations.

4. Data Sharing

We do not sell your personal data. We may share data with: service providers who assist our operations; law enforcement when required by law; and other users (only your public profile name and reviews you submit).

5. Data Retention

We retain your account data for the duration of your active account. Reviews and evidence are kept as long as the associated trade entity profile exists. You may request deletion of your account and personal data by contacting us.

6. Data Security

We implement industry-standard security measures including encryption in transit (TLS), secure password hashing, rate limiting, and role-based access controls. However, no system is 100% secure.

7. Your Rights

You have the right to: access your personal data; correct inaccurate data; request deletion of your data; object to processing; and export your data in a portable format.

8. Cookies

We use essential cookies for authentication and language preferences. We do not use third-party advertising cookies.

9. Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy from time to time. We will notify registered users of material changes via email or platform notification.

10. Contact Us

For privacy-related inquiries, contact us at: privacy@ordershieldpro.com
legal.termsContent:
1. Acceptance of Terms

By accessing or using OrderShieldPro ("the Platform"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, you may not use the Platform.

2. Platform Description

OrderShieldPro is a trade entity verification platform that allows users to submit, view, and manage reviews of trade entities (suppliers, brokers, agents). The platform provides review moderation, entity profiles, investigation requests, and verification scoring.

3. User Accounts

You must provide accurate and complete registration information. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your credentials. You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account. We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms.

4. Acceptable Use

You agree to: submit only truthful and accurate reviews based on genuine trade experiences; not submit defamatory, fraudulent, or misleading content; not manipulate reviews, ratings, or verification scores; not use automated tools to scrape or access the platform; and not impersonate other users or entities.

5. Review Submissions

Reviews you submit are subject to moderation by our service team. We reserve the right to reject, edit, or remove reviews that violate our guidelines. Published reviews become publicly visible. You retain ownership of your review content but grant us a non-exclusive license to display it on the platform.

6. Investigations & Watch Requests

Investigation requests are processed by our service team on a best-effort basis. Results are informational only and do not constitute legal advice or due diligence. We do not guarantee the accuracy or completeness of investigation findings.

7. Subscription Tiers

Features may vary by subscription tier (Free, Pro, Enterprise). We reserve the right to modify tier features with prior notice. Paid subscriptions are subject to our billing terms.

8. Intellectual Property

The Platform, its design, features, and content (excluding user-submitted reviews) are owned by OrderShieldPro. You may not copy, modify, or redistribute our platform without permission.

9. Limitation of Liability

OrderShieldPro is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for: decisions made based on reviews or entity profiles; accuracy of user-submitted content; service interruptions; or indirect, consequential, or incidental damages.

10. Dispute Resolution

Any disputes arising from these terms shall be resolved through binding arbitration in accordance with applicable laws. You agree to attempt informal resolution before initiating formal proceedings.

11. Termination

We may terminate or suspend your access at any time for violations of these terms. Upon termination, your right to use the platform ceases immediately, though your submitted reviews may persist.

12. Changes to Terms

We may modify these terms at any time. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance. Material changes will be communicated via email or platform notification.

13. Contact

For questions about these terms, contact us at: legal@ordershieldpro.com
